paint_order.evidence: When the primary resource path is active, Frame 1100 is selected and passed through the original 800x600 compositor using this+0x520/0x524 placement fields.
Frame 1101 is selected inside the count-controlled loop, with per-entry 18-byte source stride and per-entry target Y progression.
After the repeated-entry loop, the last entry index is clamped and Frame 1102 is selected and composited at this+0x540/this+0x544 plus the final 18-pixel offset.
When the primary resource path is unavailable, the function enters a separate normalized/alpha composition branch using 0x4542A0; it is not proven to be business text rendering.

White (0xFFFFFF) GBK-wrapped text at window-relative (x+0x96, y+0x28), line pitch textheight+5, scroll window [this+0x3BC]..[this+0x3BC]+[this+0x594], iterating the global node list 0x8B1AE4 (vtable 0x47694C).

Frame window (id 11, +0x516E8) paints its own option list (object +0x1E0, class 0x476A68): positions controls +0x74 at (x+0x122, y+0x3B) and +0x128 at (x+0x122, y+0x59), then iterates up to 0x13=19 lines.

confirmed: The NPC window is initialized from GameInter.wil Frame 1100 at 552x176.
The NPC object separately loads Data/NPCFace.WIL into owner+0x278; this is distinct from the GameInter handle used by the window and child controls.
The paint path selects consecutive Frames 1100, 1101 and 1102.
The dynamic list uses a count at this+0x51C and an 18-byte per-entry stride.
All three child controls have statically recovered window-relative positions.
The NPC paint entry statically orders the primary Frame 1100 composition, repeated Frame 1101 entries, final Frame 1102 entry and fallback composition branch.

The dialogue TEXT is drawn by 0x0043F460 on the same object (winmgr+0x51150), white 0xFFFFFF, GBK wrap, window-relative (x+0x96, y+0x28), pitch textheight+5, scroll window [this+0x3BC]..[this+0x3BC]+[this+0x594].
Unified window id space: model = id 9 (winmgr+0x51150), frame window = id 11 (winmgr+0x516E8), shared by paint 0x428358 / close-all 0x42B938 / show 0x42B3E4 / input dispatch 0x42C4D4.
Show is a toggle on [window+0x30]: active -> remove from open list + deactivate; inactive -> append to open list + activate (0x42ADB0).
Clicking the model panel (dispatch id 9, handler 0x440290 success) closes the dialogue via ROOT hide-all 0x41C1E0.
The frame window paints its OWN copy of the option list (up to 19 lines) in addition to the model's text panel.
ROOT is a static global object at 0x47EF18 (.data/BSS); winmgr = ROOT+0x2A548C; globals 0x8AB820/0x8B1870 hold the ROOT pointer; UI init 0x4570A0.
Option-line clicks on the frame dispatch outbound message type 0x419 via 0x451A40 (header builder 0x452940, send 0x451E60).

Server message 0x515 fills the frame option list: sub-protocol dispatch 0x4218F2 (byte table 0x42219C -> handler table 0x422168, index 3) -> 0x421A45 (unique call site 0x421A7B, frame=ROOT+0x2F6B74) -> 0x4488D0(frame, body, count) -> per line 0x468B1A alloc 0x630-byte descriptor + 0x468BF0 '/' split + whole body at desc+4 -> 0x449870 appends to frame+0x1E0; [frame+0x54]=1, [frame+0x5C]=count.

0x449870 is a generic linked-list append (12-byte nodes [data@0,next@4,prev@8]) shared with the winmgr open-list append 0x42AC3B; list class vtable 0x476A68; frame list header at +0x1E0 (head +0x1E4, walk +0x1E8, tail +0x1EC, count +0x1F4).
Frame show 0x4488B0 (vtable+0x10) sets [frame+0x30]=active and, when [frame+0x54]==0 (content not loaded), sends message 0x416 via 0x4519E0 (message object 0x8AB828, body at +0x18).

Winmgr position+show 0x42B6A0(id,x,y): close-all 0x42B820 -> remove 0x42AC50 -> re-append 0x42AC30 (raise) -> 0x423F90(1) visible -> 0x4240C0(x,y); 0x4240C0 positions only when [win+0x30] (active, 0x423F80) AND [win+0x34] (visible, 0x423F90) AND [win+0x3C] are all nonzero; per-id offsets @0x42B7E0 match the unified id map; frame placed at 0x42BCEF after frame key handler 0x448230.

Dialogue option-line descriptor (0x630 bytes): +0 action code, +4 whole body text, +0x204 len, +0x208/+0x20C action flags (cleared by fill), +0x210 hover flag, +0x214 has-field2 flag, +0x22C len2, +0x230 field2 text, +0x228 sub-list (index +0x10); paint draws lines at x=frame+0x18+0x41, y=3*i+0x12 with hover color base 0x1919C8 / normal 0x19197D.

The complete sub-protocol handler map (0x4218F2 dispatch, byte table 0x42219C -> handler table 0x422168) is decoded: 0x514->0x421BBC (flag byte ROOT+0x35B148, winmgr+0x2F8780 vtable+0x88 notify, show/hide window id 0x1D); 0x515->0x421A45 (option-list replace); 0x516->0x421AF5 (idempotent quest-log insert + chat notice); 0x517->0x421A85 (sub-list replace + chat notice); 0x518->0x4219A0 (set 3 words on object +0x61C90 or ROOT+0x35A410); 0x519->0x421BA7 (colored chat text, Chat.txt log when [ROOT+0x44]); 0x51A..0x51D->0x421CFC (0x40C record queued to ROOT+0x364458 via 0x4561B0); 0x51E->0x421B5B (sub-list append); 0x51F->0x421955 (sub-option select); 0x520->0x421C23 (timestamped object register into ROOT+0xE1184); 0x44D->0x421C81 (object action routing: id==current -> winmgr vtable+0x38, else 0x41EB10 lookup -> obj vtable+0x38); 0x4B0->0x421913 (outbound 0x40C assembly at ROOT+0x428054 via 0x41B710).

The 0x416-sending family 0x4488B0/0x448B10/0x4491D0/0x449390 are ALL content loaders of the SAME frame window (ROOT+0x2F6B74) - not other windows; the sibling 0x449870 fills 0x4491B6/0x44933E live inside 0x4491D0 (idempotent insert). Earlier store/warehouse/trade candidate hypothesis withdrawn.

0x449060 relayout = drain all nodes, bubble-sort the desc array by [desc+0] (numeric id) ascending (0x449158..0x44919F), clear each [desc+0x208], re-append via 0x449870; option list is therefore kept sorted by id.

0x4491D0(frame, body, word) = idempotent insert: unloaded -> send 0x416 (0x4491EF); per line split '/', dedup via 0x449680 list walk ([desc+0]==first field); existing -> return 0; new 0x630-byte descriptor -> 0x449870 append -> relayout 0x449060; [frame+0x5C]=count, [frame+0x54]=1.

0x448B10(frame, body, id, count) = sub-list append: unloaded -> send 0x416 (0x448B2E); walk for row with [desc+0]==id; create sub-list at row+0x228 (vtable 0x476A6C) if null; per sub-entry alloc 0x620 bytes, '/' split, inline append (not via 0x449870); [desc+0x22C]=count. 0x449390 = sub-list replace variant (send 0x416 at 0x4493AF when unloaded).
0x448D90(frame, id, text) = sub-option select: find row, find sub-entry by id, set entry+0x21C=1 (active) and copy text to entry+0x220.
0x401390 = 8-entry color table (jump table 0x4013D8): 0->0, 1->0x0A0A0A, 2->0xFFFFFF (white), 3->0xFF (red), 4->0xFF00 (green), 5->0xFF9696, 6->0x50FFFF, 7->0x80FF.
0x427E30(winmgr, c1, c2, fmt) = chat-line printer: empty fmt -> return; calls chat window (id 8, winmgr+0x507EC) method 0x4144A0(c1, fmt, c2); text rendered via 0x45E200 on 2D DC 0x8AB7A8.

(the quest log has changed), 0x47B1A4 '아이템을 모두 가지고 있지 않습니다.' (you do not hold all the items); 0x47B1C8/0x47B1EC are GBK Chinese patch strings (guild).
